sources.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
sources.note: TRACE assigns turn-level rewards during agentic RL post-training from frozen-reference gold-answer likelihood changes at tool-call boundaries. It is a dense credit-assignment/training method evaluated on a fixed trained policy, not an autonomous persistent deployment-time self-evolution mechanism.

sources.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
sources.note: RxBrain is an embodied foundation/world-model architecture trained to jointly reason in language and visual imagination. Its planning state is an inference representation; the source does not expose a persistent behavioral artifact autonomously revised from outcomes across tasks.

sources.title: NexForge: Scaling Agent Capabilities through Requirement-Driven Task Synthesis for LLMs
sources.note: NexForge synthesizes executable tasks and expert trajectories from capability requirements for supervised post-training. It is a data-generation/training pipeline rather than a deployment-time persistent self-evolving agent object.

sources.title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
sources.note: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 improves a world-action model through pretraining/finetuning and architecture optimization while decoding actions only at inference. The deployed policy is fixed and does not autonomously persistently modify itself.

sources.title: CatalogAgent: A Supervisor-mediated Self-Learning System Enabling Context Engineering for GenAI Models
sources.note: CatalogAgent turns Generator/Evaluator disagreements and seller feedback into Supervisor investigations, stores case-level Supervisor activity in a Memory Base, summarizes recurring patterns, and feeds validated learnings back through prompt, metadata, and input-context engineering. The reported worker gains are real, but the update explicitly changes the context/metadata supplied to workers and is directly derived from observed conflicts and Supervisor decisions. This is corrective distillation/context engineering with regression gating, not an irreducible self-evolution state under information parity.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No residual survives after matching conflict/seller evidence, Supervisor decisions, summarized learning content, worker context budget, update count, and held-out evaluation.
Regression-gated context updates are expressible as a constrained stability-plasticity/commit decision when gain, risk, validity, interaction, and budget information are matched.

sources.title: What Models Express, Suppress, and Resist: Auditing Open-Weight LLMs with Persona Vectors
sources.note: Persona-vector auditing characterizes natural, steerable, and resistant behavioral directions in fixed open-weight models and tests activation steering/transfer. It is a static representation/audit study rather than longitudinal autonomous self-modification.

sources.title: Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success
sources.note: OAT learns the normal dynamical flow of successful agent trajectories using a lightweight Neural CDE and attributes failure steps by deviations from that learned flow, without failure labels or frontier-model inference. It is strong component evidence for scalable failure attribution and process diagnosis, but does not update the acting agent or identify a new self-evolution causal variable.

sources.title: ToolAnchor: Anchoring Counterfactual Context to Boost Agentic Tool-use Capability
sources.note: ToolAnchor uses teacher-generated counterfactual contexts to recover failed tool-use trajectories and internalizes successful interventions through post-training. The final agent is trained offline; the source does not study autonomous persistent deployment-time self-modification.

sources.title: MetaInfer: A Knowledge Only LLM Inference Engine Generator SKILL Toolbox
sources.note: MetaInfer is a knowledge-only LLM-as-Compiler system that generates customized inference engines from runtime constraints and a Contract Knowledge Base. For uncovered models/platforms it runs controlled exploration, validation, knowledge consolidation, and revalidation before zero-reference generation. This is strong program-generation/knowledge-evolution infrastructure evidence, but the evolving object is explicit engineering knowledge used by verifier-guided code synthesis; it does not establish an irreducible agent self-evolution causal state.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: Generation from explicit contracts plus validation remains expressible as program synthesis/repair when the strongest baseline receives the same specifications, knowledge, validation transcript, and search budget.

sources.title: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
sources.note: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 is an embodied foundation-model training report spanning pretraining and post-training. It does not expose a deployment-time persistent self-evolution transition.

sources.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
sources.note: Function-aware FIM is a self-supervised mid-training objective that improves later coding-agent post-training. It changes model parameters offline and is outside the persistent deployment-time self-evolution scope.

sources.title: UMoE:Unlocking Every Expert in Domain-Specific Training
sources.note: UMoE prunes and regrows domain-misaligned experts before standard SFT under a fixed parameter/inference budget. This is an offline post-training architecture/optimization method, not an autonomous persistent agent update loop.

sources.title: ToolAtlas: Learning Once, Reusing Everywhere with Tool-Side Memory
sources.note: ToolAtlas builds persistent provider-side memory of tool traces, affordances, failure boundaries, and cross-tool compositions through execution-verified frontier probing, then reuses the same memory across heterogeneous agent frameworks and environment instances. Its transfer and ablations strongly validate tool-centered knowledge organization and deliberate capability exploration. However all evolving state is explicit tool knowledge and retrieval structure; capability/frontier probing changes knowledge coverage, while graph traversal changes selection. A strongest semantic-memory/retrieval baseline given the same tool knowledge, coverage, context budget, and utilization can express the current result.

reopen_contracts_checked.boundary: No residual is shown after matching memory knowledge count/content, affordance/boundary/composition coverage, relevance, context/token budget, backbone, and observable utilization.

sources.title: Forgetting Our Way to Shared Meaning: Effects of Forgetting on Conceptual Alignment in a Non-Partnership Coordination Game
sources.note: This work simulates conceptual alignment under different adaptiveness and memory-degradation settings. The object is a stylized social/coordination model rather than a deployed LLM agent autonomously improving its behavioral artifacts.

sources.title: Flout at Your Own Risk: LLMs Struggle with Pragmatic Cooperativity Under Epistemic Asymmetry
sources.note: The pragmatic-cooperativity study evaluates fixed agents under partial information and tests prompting/post-training remedies. It does not define a persistent autonomous self-evolution mechanism.

sources.title: DeepBias: Adaptive In-depth Probing of Social Biases in LVLMs
sources.note: DeepBias evolves an adversarial evaluation distribution with DPO using target-model responses and then performs multi-turn, response-conditioned probing via a curated DiggerAgent skill library. Its ablation shows DPO adaptation materially strengthens the later probing stage. This is strong component evidence for adaptive safety evaluation and target-aware benchmark construction; the evolving object is the evaluator/test distribution, not the evaluated target model, so it cannot reopen actor self-evolution.
